acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC2: Navigation links work with active state
acceptance_criteria.details: NavLinks component with 3 nav items (Home, Dashboard, Projects). Uses TanStack Router <Link> with activeProps for active state styling (bg-sidebar-accent). Icons from lucide-react (Home, BarChart3, FolderOpen). Labels hidden when sidebar collapsed.

ProjectSelector uses DropdownMenu pattern from ui/dropdown-menu.tsx. Shows selected project or 'Select Project' placeholder. Lists projects from Zustand store. On select: calls useAppStore.getState().setSelectedProject(id). Collapsed: shows only ChevronDown icon.

Root layout restructured to flex layout with sidebar + main area. Mobile (max-md): sidebar hidden when collapsed, absolute overlay when expanded. Desktop (md+): sidebar always visible, relative positioning. Breakpoint: md (768px). Header toggle button works on all viewports.

reasons.F021: Zustand store provides sidebarCollapsed state and toggleSidebar() action. Also provides projects list and selectedProject state for project selector.

discoveries.discovery: Flex layout with sidebar column is more flexible than grid for collapsible layouts
discoveries.context: F024 changed __root.tsx from grid-rows layout to flex with sidebar. Structure:
discoveries.lesson: For layouts with collapsible sidebar, flex parent with flex-1 child is more maintainable than grid. Sidebar width changes don't affect content size calculation.
discoveries.code_pattern: const layout =
discoveries.benefit: Content automatically fills remaining space when sidebar collapses. No need for min-width or max-width calculations. Transition is smooth without layout thrashing.

discoveries.discovery: Mobile sidebar overlay pattern uses fixed positioning with z-50 and backdrop
discoveries.context: AppSidebar uses fixed positioning (inset-y-0 left-0) for mobile overlay, hidden at md breakpoint. Backdrop: fixed inset-0 with bg-black/50 z-40. Both shown only when !collapsed.
discoveries.lesson: For mobile sidebar overlays, use fixed positioning relative to viewport, not container. Backdrop at z-40, sidebar at z-50. This prevents footer/header interference.
discoveries.code_pattern: const mobileOverlay = !collapsed && <div className="fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 md:relative">; const backdrop = !collapsed && <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 md:hidden" onClick={toggleSidebar} />;
discoveries.benefit: Mobile users see full sidebar overlay on small screens. Desktop users see inline sidebar. Single responsive component handles both cases.

discoveries.discovery: Collapsed state icons are recognizable without labels if icons are clear
discoveries.context: F024 shows only icons when sidebar collapsed: Project selector uses ChevronDown, nav links show Home/BarChart3/FolderOpen icons. User info shows Avatar icon. No tooltips, but icons are self-explanatory.
discoveries.lesson: For collapsed sidebars, ensure icons are universally recognizable (Home=house, Dashboard=chart, Projects=folder). Avoid ambiguous icons. Optional: add tooltips on hover for clarity.
discoveries.code_pattern: const navItems = [{icon: Home, label: 'Home'}, {icon: BarChart3, label: 'Dashboard'}]; when collapsed, show <icon /> only; when expanded, show <icon /><label />
discoveries.benefit: Users quickly learn collapsed layout. Icons are consistent with web conventions. Reduces cognitive load.

discoveries.discovery: Zustand store selector can be called from event handlers without re-renders
discoveries.context: AppSidebar backdrop button: onClick={() => useAppStore.getState().toggleSidebar(). This calls the store action directly, not from a selector. No re-render trigger needed.
discoveries.lesson: For event handlers that don't need the value, use useAppStore.getState().action() instead of selector hook. This avoids unnecessary component re-renders.
discoveries.code_pattern: const backdrop = <button onClick={() => useAppStore.getState().toggleSidebar()} />; vs const toggle = useAppStore(s => s.toggleSidebar); <button onClick={toggle} />
discoveries.benefit: Backdrop button doesn't cause AppSidebar re-render. Both patterns work; getState() is shorter for one-off calls.

discoveries.discovery: TanStack Router Link activeProps auto-apply active styles without checking pathname
discoveries.context: NavLinks uses <Link to={to} activeProps={{ className: 'bg-sidebar-accent text-sidebar-accent-foreground' }} />. TanStack Router automatically applies activeProps when link matches current route.
discoveries.lesson: TanStack Router Link activeProps is smarter than HTML <a>. Router compares link destination with current route and applies active classes automatically.
discoveries.benefit: No need for pathname comparison or custom hook. Active state is always in sync with current route.

discoveries.discovery: Projects data from Zustand store can be empty on first load
discoveries.context: ProjectSelector renders dropdown with projects from Zustand store. On first load, store is empty. Component shows 'Select Project' placeholder.
discoveries.lesson: When UI depends on async data (projects from API), show empty state placeholder. Don't break layout.
discoveries.code_pattern: const projects = useAppStore(s => s.projects); const selected = useAppStore(s => s.selectedProject); return <button>{selected?.name || 'Select Project'}</button>;
discoveries.benefit: UI loads instantly even if data not yet fetched. Placeholder is clear that user can interact when data arrives.

code_quality_notes.type_safety: Full type safety: Zustand selectors are typed, TanStack Router Link is typed, no 'any' types, component props are fully typed

code_quality_notes.performance: Smooth width transitions via CSS (transition-[width] duration-300). No JavaScript animation. Flex layout is performant. Mobile overlay uses fixed positioning which is performant.
code_quality_notes.ux_considerations: Sidebar icons are recognizable, labels show on desktop, icons only on mobile. Smooth collapse animation. Mobile backdrop prevents interaction with content.

architectural_insights.layout_architecture: Root layout uses flex with sidebar column. Sidebar is collapsible (w-16/w-64). Main content uses flex-1 to fill remaining space. Header fixed at top of main content, not tied to sidebar.
architectural_insights.sidebar_architecture: AppSidebar is top-level component in layout. Contains ProjectSelector (top), NavLinks (middle), UserInfo (bottom). Mobile overlay is part of AppSidebar (fixed positioning on small screens).
architectural_insights.state_management: Sidebar collapse state in Zustand UI slice (shared with other features). Projects data in Zustand projects slice (fetched by F023). No local component state needed.
architectural_insights.responsive_strategy: Single component handles both desktop and mobile via Tailwind breakpoints. md breakpoint (768px) switches between inline and overlay layouts. CSS media queries handle visibility.
architectural_insights.styling_approach: CSS variables for sidebar colors (bg-sidebar, text-sidebar-foreground, border-sidebar-border). Enables theming (light/dark mode). Tailwind utility classes for responsive layout.
